rationale: Plan_82 D11 extends the D4 rename ratchet to every tracked file; each kept spelling needs a reason and every removal lowers its baseline.

CHANGELOG.md.reason: Released history preserves the former package name and its rename record.

tests/package-name-literals.test.mjs.reason: The guard's own matching pattern and spelling probes must name the spellings they detect.

.claude/context/architecture.md.reason: The architecture explicitly states that the short alias was removed in Plan_82 D3.

tests/brand-home.test.mjs.reason: A refusal sample verifies that the legacy home environment key is rejected.

tests/cli/commands.test.mjs.reason: The help-output check includes the removed alias to detect an obsolete command spelling.

tests/cli/hook-recognizer.test.mjs.reason: A not-recognized command sample verifies that the removed short alias is rejected.

tests/package-identity.test.mjs.reason: A refusal sample verifies that immutable package identity rejects assignment of the legacy home key.
